description: Minimize mass of a rectangular prismatic aluminium cantilever: 40 mm long, 20 mm wide, thickness 2 to 8 mm, clamped root, transverse tip force 100 N. Nominal E=70000 MPa and density=0.0027 g/mm3 supplied for an analytic small-deflection screen. Hard limits: stress <=100 MPa and tip deflection <=0.5 mm. No fatigue, joints or dynamic loads.
